A few years back I had the privilege of attending a few lectures of Hazrat Moulana Anzar Shah Saheb (DB) in my local masjid. Since then, I have had a few dreams about him and would like to know their meanings. 1. I had a dream that Moulana Saheb (DB) was very weak and was about to break into pieces inside my local masjid and I was carrying him and trying to get help for him. Others were also trying to help, e.g. my brothers and friends but I did not let them and I said to then that they don't know how to help him and that only I could do this. 2. I had a dream that I wa following Hazrat Moulana (DB) around the UK as he was delivering various talks around the country and that I was also studying under him at the same time whilst he travelled around. 3. I had another dream about a famous Scholar in the UK. I dreamt that He was teaching (dars) in the dar ul uloom where he teaches. I dreamt that I was sitting infront of him and that he requested me to read and explain the book he was doing a dars of and I refused saying "How can I read anything in your presence" but he insisted and so I began reading the book. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 38540 Country: Bangladesh Title: My younger sister (cousin) dreamed that both she and her elder sister were just carrying baby Question: My younger sister (cousin) dreamed that both she and her elder sister were just carrying baby. However, she has got married for 1.5 years and no child, and her sister has already got 2 children. The dream time was before Fajr azan. I will be very pleased if you please make me know the interpretation. Answer ID: 38540 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 877/877/M=1433) It is a nice dream. In-shaAllah, there shall be happiness in the house of the sister. She should do good deeds and follow Sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
